<div class="card-body">
'''Dual Laser Cannon''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Vehicle Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">2連レーザー砲</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して任意のＴ－４７に配備する。１フォース消費して起動する。運命数を引く。キャラクターには運命数－１＞能力値で命中する。ビークルには運命数＋２＞装甲値または回避値で命中する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Dual-Laser-Cannon-PSA-160326800.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">サンドｘ２－１００レーザー砲。安価で強力なため、非合法組織でしばしば使用される。Ｔ－４７エアスピーダーに装備されることが多い。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Twin laser cannon.

'''Card text:'''
Use 2 Force to deploy on any T-47. Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny -1 > ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny +2 > armor or maneuver.

'''Lore:'''
Sund x2-100 laser cannon. Cheap and powerful, so outlaw groups often use it. Frequently fitted to T-47 airspeeders.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Dual Laser Cannon]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
